lines: Haiiiiiiiieeeeeeee!!? Not good, Fuma!! That bear is super strooooooooooooong!!
I know! For now just run for it!
I called out to the half-crying Shikanosuke to spur him on as we ran.
These animals possessed the power of the wild as well as the abilities of Taimanin. If we had a serious fight with them it wouldn't end well for us.
(More importantly, how could she tame such wild beasts!?)
Of course, by her, I meant Yukikaze, who had these animals kowtowing to her.
It didn't look like she was taking care of them for Sakura-sensei, so it was most likely pure and simple dominance.
She was a really reckless girl as alwaysー
A-Anyway just keep running and follow her! Hebiko, did you see where she went!?
Yes!! Hebiko's somehow got her scent!
The suckers on Hebiko's tentacles were excellent olfactory sensors.
If we followed that we would have no problem chasing Yukikaze, even if she had a bit of a lead on us.
We could hear the sound of the animals' growling snarls chasing us as we ran through the mountain paths.
Haa, haa... Wh-What is this place...!??
After running for what felt like a while, the dense forest suddenly opened up into a clearing before us.
What we saw towering before us was...
A mansion... or rather a castle...
It was a majestic mansion, one like the European aristocracy would live in.
And in front of it was a large and beautiful well-groomed garden.
A-Are you kidding me!? That castle is Yukikaze's houseー!!?
There was no longer any room for doubts.
Far from where we stoodー We could see Yukikaze, who looked as small as a rice grain from this distance next to the castle, waltzing right in as if it was the most natural thing to do.
She wasn't living at the top of some tree or with wild dogs.
But the truth was just as shocking.
Yeah. There was some talk of her being from a prestigious family or something but...
Well, the splendor of the castle in front of our eyes was far beyond prestigious levels though.
(But is she living all alone in that huge castle...?)
If I remember right, Asagi-sensei had said so during the incident with Clear.
But, isn't this great? You found her house so let's just give her back her notes and go home.
Oh nonono, we can't do that... We can't leave now after coming all the way here!
Right, Shikanosuke? Aren't you curious about this too!?
There's something strange about this castle!! And besides, why doesn't anyone know about such a huge place to begin with?!
Hebiko is sure that's only because it's so deep in the mountains though...
For sure! I need to know, Fuma!!
Hebiko looked dumbfounded, but Shikanosuke and I weren't stopping.
This is definitely not normal! There's got to be, like, a demon trapped inside, and that the castle moves at night!!
Oooo nice! That gets me fired up!!
Come on. Don't encourage him, Shikanosuke-chan.
Mwahaha. Well, Hebiko, the real "adventure" is only starting.
There's no way I could go back home after such an interesting turn of events!!
I nodded as I made my declaration to Hebiko.
We will now be on standby here until dark!! And then...
we infiltrate Yukikaze's house... No! We will infiltrate Yukikaze's moving castle!!
